  <div id="contentframe" style="position:absolute; top: 40%; left: 13%; color: #ffffff; font-family: Rubik; background-color: #252525;
  color: #ffffff; /* A dark gray text color */

  border-radius: 5px;

<style>

.card {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  height: 250px; /* fixed height for uniform grid */
  background: #252525;
}

.card img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 200px;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  z-index: 1; /* ensures image stays behind title */
}

.card-title {
  position: relative;
  background: rgba(37, 37, 37, 0.7); /* optional overlay just behind text */
  font-weight: bold;
  font-family: Rubik, sans-serif;
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-align: center;
  z-index: 10;             /* ensures it’s in front of the image */
  color: #ffffff;
}

</style>
